method: Four distinct repeated constructions: compact dots, balanced hyphens, close-set hyphens and wide-spaced hyphens. Measurements summarize ink spread and scan variation rather than defining synthetic target geometry.
measurement_method: Local paper sigma16; robust line fit through native mark centres in short windows. Detrended five-pixel measurement band excludes caption/body ink. Autocorrelation determines first strong period, then peak spacing limits spurious split peaks. Gaussian1px horizontal smoothing is for width measurement only. Mark heights use native grayscale half-depth at centres. No artwork is modified.
identity_limit: Correspondence concerns the repeated printing pattern, not shared physical matrices. Stock lengths and metal body sizes are preserved separately. Native ink-width variations are not regularized.

entries.name: Fine dotted leader, four-dot strip
entries.quality_todo: Seek a sharper matching historical impression during the remaining surveys. Retain native mark and spacing variation; no synthetic circles, rectangles, duplicated marks or forced seamless endpoints.

sampling.purpose: Subpixel contour fitting only; interpolation adds no source detail.

recipe.notes: Complete consecutive native marks, sampled eightfold with bilinear grayscale interpolation for subpixel contour fitting. The original scan remains authoritative; sampling adds no detail. Apply one rigid rotation from the fitted whole-run baseline. No filled gaps or independent-axis stretching.
